requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic input model that includes user_location with latitude and longitude as required float fields.
The system must define a Pydantic input model that includes one or more trial_locations, each with latitude and longitude.
The system must define optional distance_meters and duration_seconds fields in the input model to align with Google Routes outputs.
The system must define an output model that includes a normalized_proximity_score as a float between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must include metadata in the output model containing selected_trial_location, distance_meters, and duration_seconds.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with existing clinical_trials_models by reusing or extending shared location field structures.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable and consumable by evaluate_care_facade without transformation errors.
The system must validate that latitude values are between -90 and 90 and longitude values are between -180 and 180.
The system must reject input where trial_locations is empty.
The system must allow multiple trial_locations and preserve all entries for downstream selection logic.
The system must define default null handling for distance_meters and duration_seconds when routing data is unavailable.
The system must raise a validation error when user_location is missing.
The system must raise a validation error when latitude or longitude values are non-numeric.
The system must define field names and types that exactly match the contract expected by clinical_trials_service.
The system must ensure no additional undefined fields are accepted in the schema (forbid extra fields).
The system must ensure deterministic schema generation so identical inputs always produce identical serialized outputs.
The system must include clear field descriptions in the schema for all inputs and outputs to support LLM interpretation.
The system must ensure the schema does not introduce any fields not supported by evaluate_care_facade or tool_router.
